facts.value: The information about the TOEFL test refers to the internet-based test.

If you do not speak the official language of the host country, it is recommended to acquire basic knowledge of the corresponding language, especially in Latin America and China. However, this is not a requirement for application!
If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., TOEFL/IELTS), these are to be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit one proof of language proficiency.
